content.text: Guests (not signed in) can collect products in a cart before checkout. The web shop keeps the cart across page views; the cart API is also used by the mobile app.

On a product page, choosing a quantity and pressing "Add to cart" shows "Product added to shopping cart." and the cart icon in the navigation shows the total number of items.
